title: Plastik HB
description: A CMS marketing and e-commerce web app for a plastic store, built by a team of three. I was responsible for designing and implementing 90% of the UI and developing unit tests for the back-end.
contributions: Designed and implemented responsive, user-friendly interfaces for product management, categories, banners, and services
Developed comprehensive unit tests for back-end reliability
Collaborated on integrating features with front-end, maintaining proper validation and error handling
Enhanced full-stack development and UI/UX design skills
challenge: Ensuring consistency between dynamic UI elements and backend data, which initially led to mismatched displays and occasional errors. Solving this required refining front-end rendering and implementing thorough unit tests.
problems: Managing complex state synchronization between UI and backend, ensuring data consistency during concurrent updates

title: MiniLid
description: A LinkedIn-inspired mini social networking web app built by a team of three. Responsible for implementing the chatting system and dashboard functionality for both job seekers and recruiters.
contributions: Implemented real-time chat features with WebSocket optimization
Built personalized dashboards displaying relevant posts, job listings, and user interactions
Optimized API calls and implemented efficient database queries
Strengthened back-end development and real-time communication skills
challenge: Handling real-time chat synchronization and ensuring dashboards remained up-to-date without excessive API calls. Required optimizing WebSocket connections and coordinating with the front-end team.
problems: Managing WebSocket connections at scale, reducing API call overhead while maintaining real-time updates

title: Meme Gang
description: A 9GAG-inspired meme-sharing web app built by a team of three. Responsible for implementing user authentication and profile management features.
contributions: Developed secure login, registration, password reset, and profile customization using token-based authentication
Optimized request handling and implemented caching strategies
Ensured proper validation, error handling, and user experience
Enhanced back-end development and API efficiency skills
challenge: Handling redundant API calls leading to performance issues. Required optimizing request handling, implementing caching strategies, and coordinating more efficiently with front-end to minimize repeated fetches.
problems: Managing API performance with high request volume, implementing efficient caching without stale data

title: Steam Search Engine
description: Final project for Information Retrieval class. A search engine for finding games on the Steam platform with a recommendation system using K-Means clustering.
contributions: Scraped and preprocessed game data from Steam platform
Built inverted index for efficient search with TF-IDF ranking
Developed recommendation system using Scikit-learn K-Means clustering
Implemented autocomplete suggestions and filters for enhanced usability
challenge: Managing noisy data and optimizing performance. Required careful data preprocessing and algorithm optimization to handle large datasets efficiently.
problems: Handling large datasets efficiently, implementing machine learning algorithms for game recommendations

title: OpenMusic API
description: A robust and scalable music API for managing playlists, songs, and collaborations. First experience with cloud integration using AWS S3.
contributions: Designed and implemented RESTful endpoints using Hapi.js framework
Implemented user authentication and authorization using JWT
Integrated AWS S3 for album cover file uploads
Created comprehensive unit tests for code reliability and API performance
challenge: Managing relational database relationships and ensuring secure authentication. First experience with cloud services required careful architecture design and security implementation.
problems: Designing scalable database schemas, implementing secure JWT authentication, integrating cloud storage

title: Bookshelf API
description: A RESTful API for managing a collection of books with CRUD operations. Submission for Dicoding Back-End Developer Learning Path.
contributions: Created endpoints for adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting books
Implemented query parameters for filtering books by name, reading status, and completion status
Ensured proper error handling and validation for user inputs
Tested API endpoints using Postman and configured with ESLint
challenge: Building a robust RESTful API while maintaining clean code and best practices. Required careful endpoint design and comprehensive testing.
problems: Implementing proper RESTful design patterns, comprehensive error handling, and input validation

title: KeretaHB
description: Final project for Object Oriented Programming class. A train ticket booking system with focus on OOP principles and design patterns.
contributions: Designed class structure implementing encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism
Implemented Singleton and Factory Method design patterns for ticket creation
Built features for train schedule management, ticket booking, and user authentication
Ensured proper error handling and data consistency throughout the application
challenge: Managing complex relationships between classes and ensuring data consistency. Required careful OOP design and adherence to SOLID principles.
problems: Implementing complex OOP patterns, managing database transactions, ensuring data consistency
